features: Compact H.264 MegaVideo IP camera series
Available in 1.3, 1080p, 3, 5 and 10 megapixel; color, day/night and auto iris versions
Fastest frame rate camera on the market: 42 fps at 1.3 megapixel, 32 fps at 1080p, 21 fps at 3 megapixel, 14 fps at 5 megapixel, 7 fps at 10 megapixel
Dual encoder H.264 (MPEG-4 Part 10) and MJPEG
Casino mode maintains 30 fps or higher in 1080p
Binned mode to increase low-light performance and frame rate
Privacy mask, extended motion-detection grid, flexible cropping
